what_is_open: An exact or sharp polynomial-time representation of the original summary-inversion image \(\mathcal C_{n,\alpha}\) and its exact support-dependent cluster extrema remains unproved.
obstruction: The frozen core defines \(\mathcal K\) only as the closure of the admissible-summary image and defines \(\overline F\) only as the continuous extension supplied by the gap-free modulus theorem. It gives neither an exact finite representation of \(\mathcal K\) nor an evaluation algorithm for \(\overline F\). Therefore the exact image and its support-dependent extrema cannot be reduced from the frozen primitives to a finite polynomial-time computation without the compact nearest-summary optimization or black-box extension evaluation that the question excludes.
attempted: The explicit structured lattice was used to replace raw spectral extraction, including for nonreal empirical spectra, and its Wasserstein ball was written as a finite union of fixed-dimensional transport-constrained programs. This produces the honest computable outer set and report, but the frozen definition explicitly asserts no equality or inclusion between that outer set and the original summary-inversion image. Bauer--Fike localization, aggregate projectors, and positive-moment projection control law estimation but do not furnish the missing exact description of the global feasible-summary closure or the extension map. Thus substituting the computable outer set would change, rather than solve, the stated exact-image problem.
partial_result: The computable surrogate is already complete. By \(\mathrm{prop:polynomial\text{-}net\text{-}law\text{-}estimator}\), \(\widehat\lambda_n\) is a total, positive, real-law-valued estimator obtained by exhaustive minimization over a lattice of cardinality polynomial in \(n\) for fixed \(k,d_x,d_z\). By \(\mathrm{thm:honest\text{-}root\text{-}n\text{-}confidence}\), \(\mathcal C^{\mathrm{alg}}_{n,\alpha}\) is honest and has \(W_1\)-diameter at most \(2R_{n,\alpha}\). By \(\mathrm{def:cluster\text{-}report}\) and \(\mathrm{thm:cluster\text{-}adaptive\text{-}report}\), every reported interval \(I_C\) and the full report \(\mathfrak R_{n,\alpha}\) have explicit fixed-dimensional constrained-program representations with the stated support and mass guarantees. Hence an evaluable honest outer set and report exist even for summaries with nonreal raw empirical spectra; only exact computation of the original sharper summary-inversion image and its exact extrema remains unresolved.
